statement:
∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ),
  Differentiable ℝ f → Differentiable ℝ g → (∀ (x : ℝ), deriv f x = deriv g x) → ∃ C, ∀ (x : ℝ), f x = g x + C

universal.type: ∀ (x : ℝ), deriv f x = deriv g x
universal.name: h

hyps.text: ∀ (x : ℝ), deriv f x = deriv g x
hyps.name: h

goal.text: ∃ C, ∀ (x : ℝ), f x = g x + C
